info.description: Retrieve Resource Value Unit (RVU) Order Line Metrics.
info.title: Order Line Metrics

parameters.description: Limits the order line metrics calculations to orders placed after the specified date. The date and time is in ISO 8601 format, e.g 2022-06-01T10:00:00Z.
parameters.name: fromDate

parameters.description: Limits the order line metrics calculations to orders placed before the specified date. The date and time is in ISO 8601 format, e.g 2022-06-01T10:00:00Z
parameters.name: toDate
